title: Diagnostic Credit on Approved Repairs — Repair and Emergency Service Calls Terms
content:
## Clause

**Credit.** In call classes of Repair and Emergency Service Calls where the diagnostic fee is credited on a qualifying repair, the diagnostic fee the customer actually owes after any member rate is credited back. The credit is posted as a diagnostic credit naming the diagnostic fee line. It is earned when the customer approves a repair whose repair parts and repair labor subtotal, before discounts, is at least the class's minimum repair subtotal.

**Where the repair may be done.** The repair may be done on the diagnosing visit or on a follow-up call on the same unit. The subtotal is taken over the diagnosing call plus any follow-up call on the same unit booked within the credit window. It is the sum of the repair parts and repair labor lines before any discount or coverage.

**Time limit.** A follow-up repair earns the credit only when it is booked no later than the class's credit-window days after the diagnosing visit was completed.

**Counting.** Credit-window days are counted as calendar days with the diagnosing visit's completion date as day 0. A follow-up booked on the last day qualifies. The completion date is taken from the diagnosing call's record. The booking moment is taken from the follow-up call's record.

**Limits.** The credit is given once per diagnostic fee. It is never given on after-hours classes, and never when the diagnostic fee was already reduced to zero by a member rate or a recall.

## Window boundaries (hypothetical dates, 30-day window)

| Diagnosing visit completed | Follow-up booked | Day count | Earns the credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 April (day 0) | 10 May | Day 30, the last day | Yes |
| 10 April (day 0) | 11 May | Day 31 | No |
| 10 April (day 0) | 10 April, same day | Day 0 | Yes |

## Amount checks (hypothetical figures)

- A subtotal of exactly $250.00 against a minimum of $250.00 qualifies, because it is at least the minimum. A subtotal of $249.99 does not.
- Where a member rate has lowered the $89.00 fee so that the customer owes $49.00, the credit is $49.00. Where the member rate reduced the fee to zero, there is no credit.
